scope: Public videos and Shorts returned by the channel inventory; no private, deleted, paid or future material.

items.title: UX Design Thinking Behind The Best Apps
items.notes: Balance visible information and hidden complexity around the user decision. Description discusses food delivery and filters; detailed redesign steps were not verified.

items.title: This UI/UX Redesign Will Teach You More Than 100 Tutorials Combined
items.notes: Product-page hierarchy, imagery, reviews, variants, quantities and purchase actions. These topics come from the description; no detailed implementation or outcome was verified.

items.title: The UX Psychology Behind Apps People Can’t Stop Using
items.notes: Editable defaults, genuine progress and demonstrating value before registration can reduce friction. Reject the examples using threatening loss messages, fabricated urgency or misleading recurring-cost comparisons. Psychological statistics were not independently verified.

items.title: Top 3 UX/UI Redesigns That Make You Design Like a Pro
items.notes: Explain trial timing, booking details and commitment near the decision. Use relevant product imagery. Retain uncertainty in estimated prices; claims that a redesign wins are not independent experimental evidence.

items.title: Ecommerce Page Redesign: UX/UI Tips to 3.5x Conversion
items.notes: Clarify product options and answer questions near purchase decisions. Do not reproduce invented reviews, unsupported trust claims or preselected paid subscriptions. The claimed conversion improvement is unverified.

items.title: 3D Animated Hamburger Website Figma Tutorial  Smart Animate Scroll Effect
items.notes: Description identifies a layered hamburger animation using Smart Animate and scrolling. Exact tutorial steps were not reviewed. Paid supplementary materials were not accessed.

items.title: Top 5 Advanced UX/UI Design Tips and Tricks Every Designer Needs to Know About – Part 3
items.notes: Useful search starting states, order-tracking information, recognizable categories and controls suited to frequency and precision. Personalization should retain user control and predictable navigation.

items.title: Top UI/UX Design Tips - How to Design a Great Bottom Mobile Navigation Bar
items.notes: Prioritize frequent destinations; use understandable labels, consistent icons, clear selection, safe areas and restrained badges. Numerical tab, type and target-size examples are contextual, sometimes inconsistent, and not universal standards.

items.title: This Video Will Take You From Junior to Senior UX/UI Designer
items.notes: Improve input hierarchy, recipient recognition, money-entry clarity and common choices with custom alternatives. Novel controls are not inherently better. Sleep examples do not establish medical quality thresholds.

items.title: Top 7 Interactive Web Designs That Deserve an Award
items.notes: Expressive portfolios and product sites demonstrate coherent imagery, 3D and scroll storytelling. Showcase appeal and awards do not establish task usability or substantiate product claims.

items.title: Top 5 UX/UI Design Tips and Tricks Everyone Needs to Know About, Part 2
items.notes: Use informative choices, reachable actions, purposeful empty states and recognition cues. Cards and images help only when they clarify the task rather than add clutter.

items.title: Top 5 UX/UI Design Tips and Tricks Every Designer Needs to Know About, part 1
items.notes: Emphasize meaningful values, clarify visual hierarchy and show the actual product. Soft shadows are optional styling. Claimed conversion changes are not validated predictions.

items.title: UX/UI Design Tutorial in Figma  - Design Modern Website from Scratch
items.notes: Research the audience, use realistic content, reusable styles and nested auto layout, and establish a coherent landing-page hierarchy. Fictional audience assumptions and fixed frame values must not become universal design rules.

items.title: The Shortest UX/UI Design Course
items.notes: Iterate through understanding, problem definition, ideas, prototypes and testing; communicate behavior and responsiveness in handoff. Select fidelity for the research question rather than assuming higher fidelity is always better.

items.title: Create a 3D Animated Website with Figma & Dora - No Code Required
items.notes: Import a design, repair alignment, stage 3D assets and set responsive constraints. Exported designs still require verification. Historical vendor controls may have changed.

items.title: UI Design Trends Everyone Is Talking About
items.notes: Historical discussion of 3D, custom cursors, scroll storytelling, neon, minimalism and large typography. It includes a 2023 trend context; do not present this as current trend research.

items.title: 10 Game-Changing Figma Tips & Tricks Every Designer Needs to Know
items.notes: Batch edits, layout tools, reusable properties and calculations can improve consistency and speed. Verify current Figma behavior before prescribing exact shortcuts.

items.title: 3D Interactive Animation With a Rotating Effect - Figma Prototyping Tutorial
items.notes: Use matched layers and coordinated rotation, position and color to simulate spatial motion. This is a prototype technique, not a real 3D implementation or a universal animation-duration recommendation.

items.title: 3D Carousel in Figma Using Smart Animate | Prototyping Tutorial
items.notes: Coordinate carousel selection, rotation and palette changes across states. Test reverse transitions as well as the forward demonstration. Preserve clear selection without relying on decorative motion.

items.title: How to Use AI to Create Stunning Designs - Midjourney Tutorial
items.notes: Develop coherent image direction and palette, then organize app screens with reusable layout. AI tooling is historically specific; asset rights, factual accuracy and production behavior still need review.

items.title: Horizontal and Vertical Scroll in Figma - Quick Prototyping Tutorial
items.notes: Separate viewport size, clipping and overflow behavior for horizontal and vertical scrolling. Check fixed navigation and final items. The demonstrated device dimensions are examples.

items.title: Animated Navigation Bar in Figma - Prototyping Tutorial
items.notes: Build navigation variants and transitions with consistent selected states. Cover all relevant paths. Do not inherit the demonstration target size or long transition duration as production guidance.

items.title: Next-Level Burger Website Animation Made in Figma
items.notes: Two visual samples showed a dark burger-site presentation and the channel end card. No captions were available. This was not a complete frame-by-frame or usability review.
